note: CONSTITUTION Art. XIII.4: the one declared interaction model. staff.js fetches this file and renders only what it declares for the resolved role; tests/test_right_rail_mirror_interaction_model.py walks it exhaustively and a browser crawl checks the served page matches it. enabled_when is a Python boolean expression evaluated against real state (reviewed, decided, action.status, shortfall, reporting_complete, test_mode, command_pending) and is asserted against the served page at every reachable state, not only at boot. reject-offset's non-generic response classes are the Owner's Lean correction-transition's full REJECTED vocabulary (financial_engine.run_correction_transition_v1); acknowledge/record-cash/record-report/restore-test are covered for their reachable revision-conflict and generic invalid_request/transport_failure/owner_command_unavailable paths, not for defensive integrity codes unreachable through any real UI action (fixed retry payloads, no supersession path) -- a disclosed, deliberately scoped gap, not a silent one.
